title: Multi-currency seat invoicing for an identity platform
name: Identity seat invoicing

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code computes amounts across currencies? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.

choices: An error, because the precision does not match

questions.prompt: Why is tax computed once on the subtotal rather than per line and summed?
choices: Rounding once avoids accumulating per-line rounding differences, so the tax matches the rate applied to the subtotal
It makes the tax always round up
Per-line tax would be impossible because lines have different currencies

questions.prompt: A tenant has 0 active seats and SSO enabled. What does buildSeatInvoice produce?
choices: It throws for an invalid seat count
An invoice with two zero-amount lines and a total of 0
An invoice with only the seat line, since the add-on is skipped
An invoice whose total equals the SSO add-on for one seat
